 Colorado’s 8th District is at the center of the battleground again, with freshman Republican Rep. Gabe Evans defending his seat against progressive state Rep. Manny Rutinel. But Democrats are hopeful they can put the pressure on other Republican incumbents like Reps. Jeff Hurd, Lauren Boebert and Jeff Crank.
